notes: «بمعناه وإسناده» is a wording note, not a link
Ibn al-Mubarak's remark names Abu Salama where the Zuhri route stands: a variant group, never a route
Ahmad ibn Muhammad's «ما حدثنا أيوب» is a confirming remark: a variant group
Ibn Hanbal's and Abu Dawud's comments on the transmitters are scholarly remarks and are not routes
